answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 31934 Country: Pakistan Title: Please also tell me the significance of naming my child as "Azaan"? Question: Please also tell me the significance of naming my child as "Azaan"? Answer ID: 31934 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 879/551/L=1432) Azan means to inform, warn etc. It is not proper to keep it as name of a child since Azan has become a term. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
